subject.title: Cajon Valley Union School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: I am honored to be a candidate for the Cajon Valley Union School District Board of Trustees because I believe every student deserves a high-quality education in a safe, supportive, and successful learning environment. Coming from a family of educators, I have a deep appreciation for the important role public schools play in shaping future generations. As a proud CVUSD parent, School Site Council member and active classroom volunteer, I have spent countless hours serving our schools and advocating for students. As the parent of special education students attending Lexington Elementary and CVUSD Virtual Learning Academy, I understand the importance of ensuring every child receives the support and opportunities they need to succeed.

As your trustee, I will put students first by supporting fully funded classrooms, expanding opportunities in arts, stem, bilingual education, and Camp Cajon, and ensuring today’s resources are invested in today’s students. I will advocate for recruiting and retaining outstanding educators, maintaining safe and well-kept schools, practicing responsible budgeting, and conducting district business with transparency and collaboration. I will always listen to parents, educators, staff, and community members because the best decisions are made when every voice is heard and every decision is guided by what is best for our students.

text: My story begins right here - I have lived most of my life in El Cajon and attended local schools. I was appointed and then elected to a partial term in 2024 as the Area 3 Trustee on the Governing Board. Here’s why you should keep me there for the next four years-

I am an Invested Parent. I homeschool my four school-age daughters because I am passionate about education and passing on my family’s values, proving my commitment to support families in their quest for the right educational fit.

I am an Experienced Teacher. With a BA Linguistics and Minor in Spanish from SDSU, as well as a current BLCAD teaching credential, I have taught in multiple districts, including five years at Lexington Elementary.

I am a Committed Community Volunteer. I have attended Foothills Christian Church for 26 years and have been continuously involved in youth and family programs as well as elementary Sunshine Clubs, Youth Venture Teen Centers, and Ethics in Business for local high schoolers.
I am a Principled Governing Board Trustee. I transparently and consistently stand for respect, efficiency, and accountability, as demonstrated by my community engagement and my voting record.
I embody the values, experience, and dedication needed for the job –

text: It is my honor to have served you for 10 years as your Cajon Valley Union School District Governing Board Trustee. That experience gave me extensive knowledge of governance, budgeting, policy, personnel, labor relations, and strategic planning.

I worked hard to keep the district open during COVID. As we experienced such enormous challenges. I understand the importance of how critical teamwork is with fellow board members and staff to accomplish huge goals and tasks. I took an important role in the creation of our proprietary World of Work curriculum. I played an essential role in the return of our students with Congressman Issa and his team to safely return the children home.

Students deserve a world-class education that prepares them for an ever-changing workforce. Our district faces significant challenges, changing demographics, economic hardships, and a growing number of students with disabilities. Addressing these issues requires experienced leadership, fiscal responsibility, and a board committed to working together with transparency and respect.
I believe in traditional family values and understand the importance of serving as a role model for our students, families, staff, and community.

I am grateful to have earned the endorsements of Former Congressman Duncan L. Hunter, County Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk Jordan Marks, Vista Mayor John Franklin Board Trustee Karen Clark Mejia, Trustee Jim Miller and Former Governing Board Member Tamara Otero.
